title: Ripple configuration
description: Configuration for @alimaandev/ripple, dependency impact analysis for TypeScript and JavaScript.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor autocomplete and validation. Written by `ripple init`.

include.description: Glob patterns (relative to the project root) of source files to analyze.

ignore.description: Glob patterns or directory names to exclude from analysis.

aliases.description: Path aliases, e.g. `{ "@": "./src" }`. Merged with tsconfig `paths`.

tsconfigPath.description: Path to tsconfig.json, relative to the project root. Default: tsconfig.json.

affectedFiles.description: Weight of the (log-scaled) number of affected files.

entryPoint.description: Weight of whether an entry point is affected.

sharedUtility.description: Weight of how many shared utilities are affected.

publicExports.description: Weight of the target file's public export surface.

cycleMembership.description: Weight of the target being part of a circular dependency.

thresholds.description: Score thresholds that map a 0-100 risk score to a level.

diff.description: Diff command tuning. CLI flags always take precedence.

base.description: Git ref used as the change-set base when no `--base` is given.

gate.description: Minimum risk level that fails the diff gate. Defaults to `"high"`.

allow.description: Glob patterns of changed files that are analyzed and reported but never block the gate.
